description: This Java class 'ChartOfAccountsWorkbook' is responsible for generating and populating an Excel workbook with chart of accounts data for bulk import into the system. It defines the layout, lookup tables, validation rules, and default formulas to facilitate data entry and validation for account types, usage, tags, offices, and currencies within a financial software project.

classes.name: ChartOfAccountsWorkbook
classes.description: A class for constructing and populating an Excel workbook with chart of accounts data, including lookup tables, validations, and default formulas to facilitate bulk import operations.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Main method to populate the Excel workbook with the chart of accounts sheet, layout, lookup tables, validation rules, and defaults.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Configures the layout of the sheet, including setting column widths, headers, and labels.

methods.name: setAccountTypeToAccountNameAndTag
methods.description: Builds a mapping from account types to their respective account names and tags.

methods.name: addToaccountTypeToAccountNameMap
methods.description: Adds a new account name and tag entry under a specific account type key.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns an array of currency codes from the list of CurrencyData objects.

methods.name: setRules
methods.description: Applies data validation rules to columns, including dropdown lists for account types, usage, tags, offices, and currencies.

methods.name: setNames
methods.description: Defines named ranges in the workbook for lookup tables of account types, names, tags, and offices.

methods.name: setDefaults
methods.description: Sets default formulas for parent and tag ID lookups in new rows.

methods.name: setLookupTable
methods.description: Populates lookup tables for account types, account names, tags, and offices; also creates corresponding named ranges.
